title: P2 apply: request
description: The operator applies through farmctl a set of manifests from a git commit atomically: the whole set or nothing (MAN-1, MAN-2). farmctl passes the commit id and the manifests of this commit; dry_run shows the plan without writing; an object that disappeared from git is deleted only by an explicit delete list.

message.description: The commit message; the core reads its Botaru-Proposal: <id> and Botaru-Revert: <id> <reason> lines and links the commit to those proposals (PRP-19, PRP-20).

delete.description: Explicit list of objects to delete.

personas.description: Texts of the persona files that the charters of the set pin, by their SHA-256; the core checks each hash, lints the text and keeps it in the tenant of the charter (GOV-4, COM-19).

path.description: Path relative to the folder, with / as the separator.

data.description: The file bytes as git stores them in the commit, in base64.

mode.description: The git mode of the entry: a file, an executable file or a symbolic link; file when absent.

skills.description: From v0.2 (profile knowledge): the files of the skills/ folder of the farm git by skill name, each with its path in skills/<name>/ (SKL-1, SKL-2). The core lints each tree, computes its tree hash by spec/hashing.md and keeps its own copy, from which runs get the skills their role pins.

path.description: Path relative to the folder, with / as the separator.

data.description: The file bytes as git stores them in the commit, in base64.

knowledge.description: From v0.2 (profile knowledge): the documents of the folders tenants/<tenant>/knowledge/<corpus>/ of the git commit, for every corpus with source: git of a catalog in the set; the path is relative to the corpus folder. The listed documents replace the corpus's git documents: a new or changed one is ingested into the per-tenant index by a kb.ingest.v1 job, one no longer listed is deleted with its fragments (KNW-2, KNW-4, KNW-5, MAN-5).
